name: Novel Game no Wakugumi o Kaeru Novel Game.
original_name: ノベルゲームの枠組みを変えるノベルゲーム。
source:
The world's resolution has fallen from VGA to QVGA, an obvious sign that the end is near. To solve this crisis, the Automatic Hero Provision System is used to summon the main character from the outside world. Now, he must borrow the unpredictable power of his home world to somehow fulfill his task.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
世界分辨率已经从VGA下降到QVGA，这是末日即将来临的明显迹象。为了解决这场危机，使用自动英雄供给系统从外界召唤主角。现在，他必须借用家乡世界不可预测的力量来完成他的任务。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049010/]Steam[/url]]
